packages.name: Resend + React Email
packages.description: Email sending service with React Email templates
packages.installCommand: npm install resend react-email react react-dom -E && npm install -D @react-email/ui -E
packages.setupNotes: Create /web/emails/ folder for email templates. Import components from 'react-email'. Add RESEND_API_KEY to .env.local

packages.name: Storybook
packages.installCommand: npx storybook@latest init --type nextjs --skip-install && npm install
packages.setupNotes: Run 'npm run storybook' to start. Stories go in /web/src/app/components/**/*.stories.tsx

packages.name: Lenis Smooth Scroll
packages.description: Smooth scrolling library with momentum and parallax support
packages.setupNotes: Initialize in layout.tsx or create a useLenis hook. Example in components/smoothScroll.tsx

packages.name: React Hook Form
packages.setupNotes: Use with Zod for type-safe form validation
